title.value: Run marketing prospecting and SEO research

introduction.value: Comet found growth-signal e-commerce companies, built contact lists with Gmail drafts, mined Reddit for SEO questions, and audited a checkout flow.

method.value: The author used Perplexity's Comet browser agent and gave it plain-language prompts for each task. For prospecting, it found e-commerce companies showing growth signals, built a contact list, and saved outreach drafts to Gmail. For SEO research, it searched Reddit for high-intent questions from the last 7 days and emailed a summary of pain points. It also audited a checkout flow by following a process doc.

outcome.value: The source gives no measured results, only example prompts and general praise after a few weeks of use. It doesn't show output quality, error rates, or how much human review the drafts needed.

notes.value: The source is a prompt list, not a worked case, so expect to test and refine each prompt and review the Gmail drafts before sending.

Run marketing prospecting and SEO research
Comet found growth-signal e-commerce companies, built contact lists with Gmail drafts, mined Reddit for SEO questions, and audited a checkout flow.
Done with
PC
Perplexity Comet
What they did
The author used Perplexity's Comet browser agent and gave it plain-language prompts for each task. For prospecting, it found e-commerce companies showing growth signals, built a contact list, and saved outreach drafts to Gmail. For SEO research, it searched Reddit for high-intent questions from the last 7 days and emailed a summary of pain points. It also audited a checkout flow by following a process doc.
How it went
The source gives no measured results, only example prompts and general praise after a few weeks of use. It doesn't show output quality, error rates, or how much human review the drafts needed.
Worth knowing
The source is a prompt list, not a worked case, so expect to test and refine each prompt and review the Gmail drafts before sending.
Try it yourself
with
Perplexity Comet
Copy prompt
Find [number] [type, e.g. e-commerce] companies showing growth signals such as [hiring, funding, new launches], and build a contact list with company, role to target and source link. Create a Gmail draft for each one using this pitch: [short pitch]. Leave the drafts unsent and show me the list when done.
Original source: https://medium.com/@kimsuji19/how-comet-reinvents-research-and-marketing-workflows-with-use-cases-34a3679b74c5
